free_text: Given the patient has a PI-RADS 5 lesion and a rising PSA trajectory of 5.7 ng/mL, biopsy is indicated to determine the extent of the disease, as the documented prior positive biopsy finding lacks necessary surveillance details. The rising PSA trend and the high-risk MRI finding are the key factors driving this decision, leading the evidence to converge on a need for further tissue diagnosis.
